title: George Hunt Williamson as Adamski's handler and Silver Shirts editor

tellings.quote: Now, let's look at uh George Hunt Williamson. So, George Hunt Williamson was um uh it was a pseudonym.

plain: George Hunt Williamson, a man who worked beside George Adamski, one of the 1950s 'contactees' who said they met beings from space, was really using a false name, and he is said to have acted as Adamski's handler and to have earlier been an editor for the Silver Shirts, the 1930s American fascist movement led by William Dudley Pelley. The philosopher Jason Jorjani lays this out for Michels as his own research, pointing to a publication called Valor and a book called Closer Encounters. If it were true, it would tie the early flying saucer contact movement to a political group and to people steering it from behind.
